game: Mega Man Battle Network 5: Team Colonel (USA)
about: Addresses, names and descriptions only: facts about the ROM, read from Cyberworld Endless's own sources (src/emu/*.h, src/core/rom.c, docs/ROM_DATA.md). No graphics, text, sound or code of the game. See docs/SYMBOLS.md.

56.title: Another game's maps
56.how: Verify: with the ROM beside BN6's, `--atlas DIR:x0` draws its maps, ACDC Town at 0x00:0, Lan's room at 0x01:0, the harbour at 0x03:0 and the internet's from 0x80:0, with their walls, floor heights and triggers counted.

57.title: Another game's songs
57.how: Verify: `--net-biome x0` with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xsong: song 0x13 ... in slot 0x26" and the music player's song in that space ("music t60 song 089cef4c"); its sound dumped (`CYBERWORLD_AUDIO_DUMP`) does not correlate with BN6's net theme on a Central layer (`--net-biome 0 --seed 2`).

58.title: Another game's Navis
58.how: Verify: `--net-biome x0` with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xnavi: navi 60 ... at 72" and "xnavi: navi 62 ... at 74"; a bystander there stands and turns in the HeelNavi's shape and speaks with its face, and at `--seed 1 --run-depth 2` "bystander 0: list 6 74 at 52 -116" is the orange Navi, who speaks with its own face (`--talk npc`).

59.title: BN5 guest battles
59.how: Verify: in `tools/romlab` with BN5's ROM, a state in Lan's room (title, START, NEW GAME, A through the intro), the record `00 36 15 00 00 00 38 00 E2 49 00 00` with an entity list `00 22 00 00 11 25 01 00 F0` and the patch: the next frame is a battle with a Mettaur (enemy id 1, 40 HP); in the game, a BN5 layer whose area names its records (`xbattles`) fights BN5's own formations (group 0x80 map 0: Champy and Mettaur on a yellow field).

60.title: BN5's text
60.how: Verify: `build.py test` (test_xtext and test_xchips, on made-up bytes); the guest's line as its boot ends names how many of BN6's chips pair by name (114 before, 118 with it: those four).

61.title: BN5's results screen, its second reward and BugFrags
61.how: Verify: `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=1 CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 tools/play.py start NAME --seed 1 -- --scene emu --net-biome x0 --dev quiet,gem,onehit` (`gem`: a Mystery Data of row 0 in every guest battle), then `battle; wait 1000` and `wait 270`: the Mystery Data says GET!, the screen shows "200 z" then "BugFrag 1", the log "its results screen gave 40C8 and C001", and the state after it `zenny 200` and `bugfrags 1` (the build before, with the switch alone: `bugfrags 0`); seed 4 without `onehit`, the autopilot breaks it and the second word is 0000; with no switch, Oran Area's record `0x0812153C` (byte 2 0x17; `--net-biome x4 --seed 1 --dev quiet,onehit`) finds Tornado L, in \* with All \* (`--setup endless,0,0,8`).

62.title: BN5's random numbers
62.how: Verify in the game, with BN5 beside BN6: `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 build.py shot --scene emu --net-biome x0 --seed S --dev quiet` with the arrival's words paged and `0:battle` (the layer's first random battle) prints "guest: its random numbers from seed ..." (seed 1: `85EBCA77`, words `9BB31115` and `DCB010DD`); seed 1's first Custom screen offers Vulcan1 D, seed 2's Recov10 A, seed 3's and seed 4's a Cannon A in other hands; seed 1 run again, or with RIGHT held as the battle comes, gives the same picture.

63.title: BN5's battle for the autopilot and the dev switches
63.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=1 CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 build.py shot --scene emu --run-depth 1 --net-biome x0 --seed 1 --frames 6000` wins its guest battle at 100 HP (Cannon on the Mettaur, the buster on the Powie; where the button pattern the autopilot pressed before was deleted), and the battle step with `--dev quiet,onehit` shows its viruses at 1 HP on the first Custom screen.

65.title: The chip registry: BN5's chip tables read
65.how: Verify: WideSht1's card in BN6's Custom screen reads "WideSht1", L, Aqua, 70 with BN5's picture (`docs/MULTIROM.md`, The chip registry); MrkCan1's in the folder editor its own description.

68.title: BN5 DarkChips
68.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, a guest battle with `--dev darkchips=0x3,worried` (`--talk guest:200`, by hand: use a chip in the first turn) offers DrkSword on the second Custom screen with the cursor on it; used, MegaMan turns dark, and after the battle `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "dark: a DarkChip used: max HP 100 -> 80" (a battle without one prints nothing); a capture with `--talk dark:430` on that layer prints "xnavi: list 7 0x68 of ... at list 7 160, 4012 bytes" and shows the purple flame and MegaMan's words.

71.title: The run's buster in BN5's battles
71.how: Verify in the game: an Attack+1 run (seed 6's layer-1 gift with `--run-depth 1 --net-biome x0`, placed and RUN in the NaviCust, STATUS then showing Attack LV 2) prints "guest: battle ..., buster Attack 2, Speed 1, Charge 1" and "guest: its battle's buster Attack 2, Speed 1, Charge 1" with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1`, and its first shot takes a Mettaur from 40 HP to 38.

72.title: BN5's Navis as guardians
72.how: Verified in romlab with BN5's ROM: KnightMan's V1 record forced from Lan's room (its GAME OVER bit cleared, the guest's way) ran his battle, KnightMan at 600 HP on panel (6,2) (his battle object `0x0203B2D8`, +0x24 the HP); his V1 stats row written `0x01C2` first spawned him at 450 of 450; with options `0x02` added a won battle showed the results screen with his row's KnightMn K (`0x14FE`), none without; Colonel's V2 (0x03) and the V3s run as battles of their own.

73.title: BN5's Souls
73.how: Verified in romlab from Lan's room after the intro, a folder of AirHoc Q (Break) owned: with KnightMan's flag 0x000C alone no UNITE stood; with flag 0x0000 too UNITE stood grey under OK, lit with an AirHoc picked, and UNITE then OK united MegaMan with KnightMan's Soul; with flag 0x0236 and DarkDril D picked, Chaos Unison, its charged shot the DarkDril's drill.

74.title: BN5 map objects
74.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1 build.py shot --scene emu --net-biome x0 --run-depth 2 --dev pieces=16 --seed 6` prints "xnavi: list 7 0x1 of ... at list 7 146, 4335 bytes" and "blockers: lock 0, kind 5, variant 9, at world 120,108"; a capture with MegaMan put down at 70 100 shows the green cube in a walkway's mouth, and with flag 0x1465 set (`0:flags 0x1465 0x1465 1`) A at it enters the P-Code: it opens its eyes and flickers out.

93.title: Net maps' backdrops and animations
93.how: Verify: in romlab, warped into each BN5 map, its BG palette (`0x05000000`, dumped every 32 frames) changes in those banks and no others; with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xbackdrop: ... map 0x90:0's backdrop and animations for 0x90:0" (0x93:0 for 0x91:1, 0x94:3 for 0x92:0), a capture of `--net-biome x0`, `x2` or `x3` over a few hundred frames shows BN5's backdrop moving and the GFXAnim slots at `0x020094C0` naming the copies, and BN6's own areas (`--seed 11` dresses none) draw frame for frame as without BN5.

98.title: Battlefields and their panels' types
98.how: Verify: `build.py xdiff field_poison field_grass field_ice` (BN5's own battle and BN6's on the field, every panel's type and flags compared each frame: poison and grass PASS over 600 frames, MegaMan on poison losing 1 HP each 7 frames in both; on ice one press slides MegaMan two rows on the same frames in both, a smoke spec); the lava trial, a spec of `"field": "73:8B"` (BN5's 0x73 against BN6's own 0x8B of the same nibbles), `"mm": "12"`, `"keys": [[40, "RIGHT", 2]]`: BN5's MegaMan 50 HP down at t46, BN6's none (`field_lava`, the same against BN6's 0x56 with lava brought in: PASS); `build.py xrecords` names each record's field as BN6's; the xrecord step on `811DE10` (holes at columns 3 and 6 of rows 1 and 3) and `812153C` (grass), each a picture of BN6's battle in BN5's layout.

99.title: BN5's lava and sea in BN6's engine
99.how: Verify: `build.py xdiff` (BN5's own battle against BN6's frame by frame, every panel's type, flags and timer): `field_lava` (MegaMan steps onto lava, 50 HP down at t46 and the panel plain, the spark's random number drawn, in both), `field_lava_aqua` (MegaMan made Fire on lava unhurt, CanGard's reticle made Aqua cooling it at t194, the hit doubled), `field_lava_firevirus` (a Fire CanGard on lava unhurt, the lava blinking from t899 and plain at t959), `field_lava_74`-`76` (on `76` CanGard on lava 50 down and the panel plain as the battle opens), `field_sea` (a Fire CanGard on sea 1 HP down each 7 frames till t959), `field_sea_43`-`45` (MegaMan on sea unhurt): PASS; `build.py xdiff --mutations` (lava's flags, its hooks taken off, the cooling's panel, the spark's random number, the element hit's lava test: each FAILs its spec); `build.py xrecords` (no record held back by a field now); the xrecord step on `811E33C` (Nebula Area's lava field as BN6's 0x56), pictures with BN5's lava, MegaMan stepping onto it from 100 HP to 50 under the spark, the panel plain.

116.title: The ROMs screen's faces
116.how: Verified by drawing BN5's list 8 as a sheet, each index labelled (0x45 and 0x5B Colonel, the empty black boxes at 0x07-0x0A, 0x2A, 0x2C, 0x40-0x44 and 0x51-0x55), and by `--scene launcher` with both ROMs: the BN5 cartridge shows Colonel, the BN6 one MegaMan.

123.title: The All * helper
123.how: Verify: with All *, three Cannon * staged as a first hand's first picks show "PrgAdvance" and GigaCan1 (with `0x2A01` left there, three Cannons fire one by one); the gift's TimeBom2 (codes C D E) reads TimeBom2 * in the PET's pack, and a folder's Sword moved to the pack and back reads Sword * there and in the folder.

132.title: Virus families moved into the battle engine: the second-level dispatch
132.how: Verify: `tests/test_emu.c`'s dispatch test runs the code on mGBA with a driver of its own: a moved type spawned as the dispatch type with its number in the side table and run as its MOVED routine (r1 its number x 4), a twin spawned as BN6's number, a stray let go as it first runs; `build.py xdiff` (CanGard's reticle, BN5's 0x25, through the third kind's dispatch in every `cangard_*` spec, the trace reading the side table: docs/DEVTOOLS.md); `--mutations`: a wrong MOVED entry, a wrong TWIN and a spawn left aimed at BN6's spawner each FAIL `cangard_v1`; `tools/xcontrol.py` and `tools/xfamily.py --spec native`: BN6's own battles the same at every byte with the dispatch made.

136.title: BN5's CanGard
136.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xfamily.py` (each block's CRC32 and each immediate checked as it is copied): in BN6's battle beside a Mettaur its states 8, 9 and 10, its reticle walking from its panel to MegaMan's and striking him for 10 (V1), its muzzle's blast; freeze, bubble, paralysis and drag each letting its reticle go; each version deleted, its MaxHP its struct2 row's (60, 120, 150, 180, 230, 280), BN6's delete counts unchanged.

137.title: BN5's records in BN6's engine
137.how: Verify: `build.py xrecords` (214 random records of the six areas, 52 fightable with CanGard and Handi installed: ACDC Area 21 of 34, SciLab 26 of 36, Nebula Area 2, Oran Area 2, the Undernet 1; 44 with CanGard alone; each area's rolls the same twice from one seed and none past its band); the xrecord step on `8121898` with `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=weak`: CanGrdEX and BN6's Mettaur, a green Mystery Data at row 3, column 4 that stood to the end, and the results screen's 200 zenny (CanGrdEX's row: a chip BN6 lacks) then 2000 zenny, BN5's row 2's find.

138.title: BN5's Handi
138.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xdiff.py handi_v1 --story` (its teleports to 4,1 at t46, 4,2 at t376 and 4,3 at t1036, its bombs at t87, t417, t747, t1077, MegaMan 50 down at t306, t636 and t966, in both games) and the other `handi_*` specs, all PASS with rng=replay; `--mutations`: the three of Handi's breaks FAIL.

139.title: The engine's differing twins
139.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xrecipe.py --report` (`.build/xrecipe/report.md`: each family's calls by class, each condition checked); `build.py xdiff` for CanGard's and Handi's.

140.title: The recipe generator's reads of BN5
140.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xrecipe.py --check` (the generated file is what the generator writes); `build.py test` holds the generated recipes of the installed families to the installed ones, field for field.

141.title: The differential's view of a battle in both games
141.how: Verify: `python3 tools/xdiff.py cangard_v1 --story`: both traces hold MegaMan, CanGard and its reticle in their kinds' arrays (each object's +0x30 the same once BN5's word is read as the BN6 entry at its place in the tables: MegaMan's `0x08410000` as `0x08410080`, CanGard's `0x04210000` as `0x04210080`; with `--survey` no difference left at +0x30), the run order names MegaMan first and the reticle after CanGard, the sound 0xAE begins on player 4 in both as the reticle fires (t76), and both RNG words agree each frame.

142.title: The differential's hooks on both cores
142.how: Verified: `python3 build.py xdiff`, every spec's events in both traces (each draw, spawn, sound, effect and setAttack of CanGard's and Handi's at the same call sites, its draws replayed: handi_v1 4033 of BN6's draws, none unmatched); `python3 tools/xcontrol.py`: the control's runs replay each of the native run's 8800 and 10783 draws and stay the same frame for frame.
